stem: Which statement about the zeros of \(h(x) = 3(x - 5)(x + 7)\) is true?

options.label: A
options.text: The zeros are 15 and -21 because \(h(15) = 0\) and \(h(-21) = 0\).

options.label: B
options.text: The zeros are -15 and 21 because \(h(-15) = 0\) and \(h(21) = 0\).

options.label: C
options.text: The zeros are 5 and -7 because \(h(5) = 0\) and \(h(-7) = 0\).

options.label: D
options.text: The zeros are -5 and 7 because \(h(-5) = 0\) and \(h(7) = 0\).
